migrations.description: Create managed schemas, pgcrypto and the immutable migration ledger.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Restore the verified pre-migration snapshot; on an empty disposable environment only, remove the managed schemas and reapply.

migrations.description: Create the canonical Green Hive application registry.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; dropping hive.apps is permitted only before any app or project data exists in a disposable environment.

migrations.description: Create app-neutral profiles linked to the Supabase authentication authority.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; restore profiles from a verified backup before any destructive table removal.

migrations.description: Create app-neutral projects with owner, app and lifecycle constraints.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; export and verify projects and dependent settings before any destructive rollback.

migrations.description: Create locale and app-neutral project settings with a composite app boundary.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; restore project settings from a verified backup before removing the table.

migrations.description: Create trusted Supabase JWT context helpers and owner/admin RLS policies.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Deploy a forward policy correction; emergency rollback revokes affected grants only during a controlled maintenance window.

migrations.description: Create organizations and memberships, including backfill-safe personal workspaces.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; export and verify organizations, memberships and their user references before any controlled restoration.

migrations.description: Create organization app installations and optional app-scoped memberships.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; export and verify app installations and app-scoped memberships before any controlled restoration.

migrations.description: Add immutable organization scope to projects and project settings.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; preserve and verify the organization mapping for every project and setting before a controlled restoration.

migrations.description: Create trusted organization selection, workspace provisioning and tenant-aware RLS.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Deploy a forward tenant-policy correction; emergency rollback revokes affected organization grants only during a controlled maintenance window.

migrations.description: Create append-only tenant audit events and transactional core lifecycle capture.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; export and verify audit events before disabling only the affected capture trigger during controlled maintenance.

migrations.description: Create app-scoped products and immutable versioned price catalog tables.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; export and verify the complete product and versioned price catalog before any controlled restoration.

migrations.description: Create tenant purchase and payment records with server-authoritative pending purchase creation.
migrations.rollbackStrategy: Prefer a forward fix; export and verify purchases, payments, audit events and immutable price snapshots before any controlled restoration.
